title: Fab City Index Reading
description: One of the fourteen readings the Index asks of a city, as the position paper of November 2026 defines them. They live as a list under `readings:` in readings.yaml; scripts/validate.py checks each one against this schema, that no id repeats, that there are exactly fourteen, and that every `cells` value names a file in cells/.

id.description: R1 to R14. The number is the reading's place in the request and never changes once a city has answered it.

name.description: The reading as the design's request table names it.

plain.description: One sentence a city lead understands: what we ask for.

why.description: One sentence from the position paper on why the Index asks for it.

unit.description: The unit or units the figure is sent in, e.g. 't/yr and %'.

years.description: The years asked for, or `latest` where the reading asks for the latest years a city holds.

held_by.description: Who in a city usually holds it.

tests.description: Which part of the Index the reading tests: a term of FCI = DIDO · (1 − PITO) · ρ, or the floor or the ceiling read beside the score.

cells.description: The Index cells the reading belongs to, in the spelling of cells/*.yaml and `feeds_cells`.

not_held.description: What to send when the city does not hold it.

prompt.description: The brief a person gives an AI agent to look for this reading. The city-data page fills its five placeholders, so it carries all five and no other braces.

es.description: The Spanish copies of the texts a person reads. `held_by` is optional; the Spanish page shows it the way the English page shows `held_by`.
